ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic, authoritative, and forward-looking tone, emphasizing business impact and competitive advantage.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Analytical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a data-driven, analytical, and objective tone, focusing on quantifiable metrics and technical rigor.

ToneOptions.Label: Action-Oriented & Concise
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ an action-oriented, concise, and direct tone, prioritizing clear recommendations and executive summaries.

ToneOptions.Label: Visionary & Transformative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a visionary and transformative tone, highlighting innovation and the future of IT operations management.

GoalOptions.Label: Market Leadership
GoalOptions.Text: Establish the Predictive IT Infrastructure Failure Detection system as the undisputed market leader. This involves demonstrating superior predictive accuracy, broader infrastructure coverage, and a clear return on investment for enterprise clients. Success means capturing significant market share and setting the industry standard for proactive IT management.

GoalOptions.Label: Revenue Growth
GoalOptions.Text: Drive substantial revenue growth by clearly articulating the system's value proposition to key decision-makers. Focus on quantifiable cost savings from reduced downtime and operational efficiencies. Success is measured by exceeding sales targets and securing large enterprise contracts.

GoalOptions.Label: Competitive Differentiation
GoalOptions.Text: Clearly differentiate the ML Inference-based solution from existing monitoring tools and less advanced predictive analytics. Highlight unique capabilities in early failure detection and root cause analysis. Success means positioning the system as a must-have for modern IT operations, outmaneuvering competitors.

GoalOptions.Label: Operational Excellence
GoalOptions.Text: Enable IT operations teams to achieve unprecedented levels of uptime and efficiency. The system should demonstrably reduce critical incidents, minimize manual intervention, and optimize resource allocation. Success is defined by a measurable decrease in unplanned downtime and improved IT service delivery.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability
Criteria: Quantifiable ROI for target customer segments.
Clear competitive advantage against existing solutions.
Scalability to meet enterprise demand and growth.
Alignment with key business objectives and strategic priorities.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Efficacy
Criteria: Accuracy and precision of ML failure predictions.
Breadth and depth of infrastructure component coverage.
Performance and scalability of the data ingestion and analysis pipeline.
Robustness of alert mechanisms and integration with ITSM tools.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Adoption & Integration
Criteria: Ease of deployment and agent management.
Seamless integration with existing IT monitoring and cloud platforms.
User-friendliness of the interface for IT operations teams.
Demonstrated reduction in mean time to detect (MTTD) and resolve (MTTR).
